name: chilli
sowing_season: Kharif: nursery May–June, transplant June–July | Rabi: nursery September–October | Summer: nursery January–February
harvest_season: Green chilli from about 60 days after transplanting; red chilli 90–120 days after transplanting, picked every 7–10 days
soil: Well-drained loam or black soil rich in organic matter, pH 6.0–7.0; cannot stand waterlogging

stages.name: Nursery / Seedling
stages.description: Seedlings are raised in raised nursery beds for 35–40 days.
stages.irrigation: Light watering daily with a rose can; do not keep the beds soggy.
stages.fertilizer: Mix 2 kg FYM per square metre into the beds. Treat seed with Trichoderma 4 g per kg.
watch_for: Damping off — seedlings collapse at the base
Thrips and whitefly carrying leaf curl virus
tips: Seed: 400–500 g per acre for varieties, 80–100 g for hybrids
Cover the nursery with a 40–50 mesh insect-proof net

stages.name: Transplanting / Establishment
stages.description: 35–40 day old seedlings are planted in the main field.
stages.irrigation: Irrigate right after transplanting, then every 4–5 days (or a short daily drip).
stages.fertilizer: Basal: 8–10 tonnes FYM + 50 kg DAP + 40 kg MOP + 25 kg urea per acre.
tips: Transplant in the evening; spacing 60 × 45 cm
Two rows of maize around the field act as a barrier against whitefly and thrips

stages.name: Vegetative Growth
stages.irrigation: Every 5–7 days in furrows, or daily by drip.
stages.fertilizer: Top dress 35 kg urea per acre at 30 days after transplanting.
watch_for: Thrips and mites causing leaf curl
tips: For thrips spray Fipronil 5 SC 1.5 ml/litre or Spinosad 45 SC 0.3 ml/litre
For mites spray wettable sulphur 80 WP 3 g/litre

stages.name: Flowering / Fruit Set
stages.description: Flowers open and the first fruits set.
stages.irrigation: Keep the moisture even — water stress now makes flowers drop.
stages.fertilizer: Second top dress: 35 kg urea per acre at 60 days after transplanting.
watch_for: Flower drop in heat or water stress
tips: Too much urea gives leaves, not fruit
For fruit borer spray Emamectin benzoate 5 SG 0.4 g/litre

stages.name: Picking
stages.description: Green fruits are picked every 7–10 days; red chilli is left to ripen on the plant.
stages.irrigation: Every 7–10 days; stop a week before the last picking of red chilli.
stages.fertilizer: After 2–3 pickings, 20 kg urea + 10 kg MOP per acre keeps the plants bearing.
watch_for: Fruit rot and die-back — sunken dark spots on ripe fruits, branches drying from the tip
tips: For fruit rot and die-back spray Mancozeb 2.5 g/litre or Copper oxychloride 3 g/litre
Dry red chilli on a clean tarpaulin, not on the bare ground

common_pests.name: Thrips
common_pests.symptoms: Leaves curl upward; silvery scars on fruits
common_pests.control: Fipronil 5 SC 1.5 ml/litre or Spinosad 45 SC 0.3 ml/litre

common_pests.name: Mites
common_pests.symptoms: Leaves curl downward and become narrow; plants look bushy

common_pests.name: Whitefly
common_pests.symptoms: Tiny white flies under leaves; leaf curl virus spreads
common_pests.control: Yellow sticky traps 10 per acre; Thiamethoxam 25 WG 0.2 g/litre

common_pests.name: Fruit borer
common_pests.symptoms: Holes in fruits with a caterpillar inside
common_pests.control: Emamectin benzoate 5 SG 0.4 g/litre; pheromone traps 5 per acre

common_diseases.name: Leaf curl virus
common_diseases.symptoms: Small, crinkled, curled leaves; stunted plants with few fruits
common_diseases.control: No cure — remove affected plants early, control whitefly and thrips, raise seedlings under net

common_diseases.name: Fruit rot and die-back (anthracnose)
common_diseases.symptoms: Sunken dark spots on ripe fruits; twigs dry from the tip downward
common_diseases.control: Mancozeb 2.5 g/litre or Copper oxychloride 3 g/litre

common_diseases.name: Powdery mildew
common_diseases.symptoms: White powder under the leaves, leaf fall
common_diseases.control: Wettable sulphur 80 WP 3 g/litre or Hexaconazole 5 EC 1 ml/litre
